title: Banff Kananaskis Bear Country Wildlife Focused Guided Hikes
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
This is a new product, this is why it has no reviews yet. Join Bear Country Guiding & Consulting for an unforgettable wildlife-focused interpretive hiking adventure in the heart of the Canadian Rockies, in Banff, Yoho Kootenay and Kananaskis. Each hike includes a bear/wildlife awareness and safety field program through which we promote human-wildlife coexistence. Thus, by signing up for a trip with us you support the wildlife conservation efforts.

The locally owned and operated company is dedicated to connecting you with the region’s spectacular landscapes and the magnificent wildlife that inhabits them. Led by your knowledgeable, professional interpretive hiking guide, who is also a biologist specialized in human-bear coexistence, your hike is designed to offer an educational and inspiring experience.

Whether you are a curious traveler, an avid hiker and/or photographer, the customizable hikes are tailored to foster respect for wildlife and promote environmental stewardship.
